verdict.rationale: Raygun's AI Error Resolution prompts an LLM (OpenAI or Azure OpenAI) with stack trace, environment and affected-code context, and returns suggestions on the root cause and how to fix the error. This covers the 'draft a fix' half of the story, but only as chat suggestions inside Raygun. Nothing shows the AI writing a code change or opening a pull request. The GitHub, Bitbucket and GitLab integrations are only documented for linking repos and decoding source maps, so they earn no credit here. Missing for 10: automated generation of a code patch, opening a pull request against the repo for human review, and independent or hands-on corroboration of fix quality.
